caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a roughly hourglass-shaped vessel or pouch, rendered in pencil or graphite on a plain, beige background. The object is shaded to suggest three-dimensionality, with darker shadows on the right side and some lighter highlights on the left. The top of the object is slightly flared and narrow, with an uneven rim, and the body curves outward in the middle before tapering slightly and then widening toward the base. There is a faint, uneven horizontal line near the bottom of the object, possibly indicating a boundary or texture. At the bottom of the drawing, there is a faint horizontal line with measurement marks labeled "5 1/2" and "7" nearby.
